verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. Both live workflows now run an unconditional credential purge after the rotation write-back and before either target-controlled rustup or cargo gate step. The purge removes the isolated HOME and all host-side `.credential-*`/selection artifacts, re-scans for residue, and exits nonzero if removal is incomplete; because the later target steps use ordinary `if:` conditions, that failure prevents them from running. The tests are materially non-vacuous: they demonstrate discovery through RUNNER_TEMP before purge and absence afterward, cover both residue regions, exercise moved-late and deleted workflow mutants, pin `always()` and terminal failure behavior, and prove an unremovable readable credential fails closed. Step-output routing also avoids restoring the former job-wide pointers while retaining the write-back tamper baseline. No reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
